experiment: Bounded frequency and spatial sensitivity of the existing audio-derived regional experiment

policy.regional_grid: Add rectangular outer rings to the original observer lattice; preserve every original observer exactly and terrain-sample added observers.
policy.pair_selection: Rank all supplied tracks over the expanded region at every stage; retain that stage's top three distinct ordered pairs and every previously retained pair.
policy.refinement: Union previous per-pair observer points with each new terrain-sampled local and fine grid; retain original baseline local/fine points. Do not discard a previously sampled better location when recentering.
held_fixed: all 320 measured event points and gaps
policy.stability_gate: The final two successive transitions must retain the same ordered pair, meet every declared change tolerance, and have no winning observer, frequency, clock or coarse-filter boundary. Preserve alternative-pair boundary flags separately.
policy.interpretation: Finite numerical stability conditional on the supplied date, tracks, retained pairs and fixed model assumptions. Frequency and spatial ranges widen together; this does not isolate their individual causal contributions. Track coverage is not enlarged by fetching new data. Stability is not calibrated uncertainty, detection accuracy, surveyed location accuracy or global uniqueness.
